battle.name: 1948 公路
battle.theater: 特拉維夫至耶路撒冷公路走廊
battle.brief: 一九四八年五月十五日以色列宣布建國，次日阿拉伯聯盟七國聯軍大舉進攻。特拉維夫到耶路撒冷的公路是耶路撒冷唯一的陸路命脈，三月末已被阿拉伯部隊完全切斷。卡面這件M4雪曼中型坦克是一九四八年美國軍援中才成批交付以色列的裝備，火力可靠、妥善率高，但身重路窄，縱深與縱隊仍靠卡車與裝甲車護送。

kit.name: 謝爾曼
kit.history: 可靠、好修、數量大，後期 76 公厘與螢火蟲等改裝補穿深。單車對虎常吃虧，師的妥善率則相反。

countries: 交戰的一方是一九四八年五月十四日宣布建國的以色列，另一方是阿拉伯國家聯盟七個成員國組成的聯軍。以色列建國之前沒有常備軍，實際作戰的是哈加納的常備組織、帕爾馬赫的全志願部隊，以及伊爾貢與萊希兩支武裝組織；五月二十六日這四股武裝合併為以色列國防軍，參謀長一職先後由雅科夫·多里與伊加爾·雅丁擔任，國防軍以旅為基本作戰單位，尼格夫旅、哈雷爾旅（後稱伊夫塔赫旅）、耶路撒冷前線司令部所屬各旅與第八裝甲旅分置北部、中部、南部與耶路撒冷四條戰線。阿拉伯聯軍方面由英軍參謀系統在幕後統一規劃，開羅的中東司令部負責聯軍的協同，英國將軍約翰·巴戈特·格魯布長期指揮外約旦的阿拉伯軍團；埃及派出巴勒斯坦遠征軍，步兵師由元帥阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿梅爾在開羅統籌，納吉布准將在南部前線直接指揮；約旦的阿拉伯軍團是全軍中機動性最高的一支；敘利亞投入步兵營與砲兵營；伊拉克以一個師的兵力經約旦進入戰場；黎巴嫩與沙烏地阿拉伯只投入象徵性部隊。另有以法烏茲·卡武基為首的阿拉伯解放軍志願兵部隊參戰，其中不少志願者曾在二戰歐洲戰場服役。
countriesEn: One side was Israel, which declared independence on 14 May 1948; the other was the coalition of the seven members of the Arab League. Before independence Israel possessed no regular army: the fighting was done by the standing organisation of the Haganah, the all-volunteer forces of the Palmach, and the two armed organisations, the Irgun and Lehi. On 26 May these were merged into the Israel Defence Forces, with the post of chief of staff held first by Yaakov Dori and later by Yigal Yadin. The army was built on brigades: the Negev Brigade, the Har'el Brigade (later the Iftach Brigade), the brigades of the Jerusalem Front Command and the Eighth Armored Brigade covered the northern, central, southern and Jerusalem fronts. The Arab coalition was planned behind the scenes by the British staff system, with the Middle East Command in Cairo coordinating the combined forces; General John Bagot Glubb commanded the Transjordan Arab Legion for most of the war. Egypt sent the Palestine Expeditionary Corps, its infantry divisions directed in Cairo by Field Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer, with General Nagib commanding directly on the southern front. The Arab Legion was the most mobile formation in the coalition; Syria committed infantry and artillery battalions; Iraq entered with a division routed through Transjordan; Lebanon and Saudi Arabia contributed token detachments. The Arab Liberation Army, led by Fawzi al-Qawuqji, also took part, and many of its volunteers had already served on European battlefields in the Second World War.
people: 決定這條公路攻防節奏的，是一串分屬兩邊的指揮官。以色列方面，總理大衛·本-古里安力主在英軍撤走前完成建國並立刻組軍；參謀長雅科夫·多里在五月二十六日接手國防軍，參謀長伊加爾·雅丁隨後接管全軍作戰計畫；伊扎克·拉賓在內戰期間指揮「拿順」行動，負責打通特拉維夫到耶路撒冷的公路，其後又參與策劃「但尼」行動，直接決定這條走廊的寬度；摩西·達揚則在耶路撒冷前線與「瑪卡比」作戰中指揮傘兵與步兵的突擊。外約旦方面，國王阿卜杜拉命令英籍指揮官古魯布·帕夏於五月十七日把部隊開進耶路撒冷，格魯布與英軍參謀總部保持密切連繫，也正是他主張在公路與山脊上以縱深封鎖拖住以色列的推進；埃及方面，元帥阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿梅爾在開羅統籌遠征軍，納吉布准將在南部前線指揮那支裝備英式輕坦克的部隊。空中，莫德凱·霍德從加利利航空中隊與內格夫航空中隊的飛行員中，鍛出一支只有十幾架戰鬥機的隊伍，英軍在中東留下的老式螺旋槳機是他必須面對的對手。公路上的具體執行，則交給各旅的後勤與巡邏隊以及護送車隊的指揮官，許多人當時還只是營長級的骨幹。
peopleEn: The tempo of the fighting on this road was set by commanders on both sides. In Israel, Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion insisted on declaring independence before the British withdrawal was complete and on raising an army immediately; chief of staff Yaakov Dori took over the Israel Defence Forces on 26 May, and chief of staff Yigal Yadin afterwards assumed control of operational planning. Yitzhak Rabin commanded Operation Nachshon during the civil war, opening the road from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, and later helped plan Operation Dani, which decided the width of this corridor. Moshe Dayan commanded the paratroop and infantry attacks of the Jerusalem front and Operation Maccabi. On the Transjordan side, King Abdullah ordered his commander, the British officer Glubb Pasha, to enter Jerusalem on 17 May; Glubb stayed in close contact with the British General Staff and argued for blocking the Israeli advance along the road and the ridges. In Egypt, Field Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer directed the expeditionary force from Cairo, and General Nagib commanded on the southern front the force equipped with British light tanks. In the air, Mordechai Hod built out of the pilots of the Galilee and Negev squadrons a force of barely more than a dozen combat aircraft, facing the older British-designed propeller types left in the Middle East. On the road itself, execution fell to the logistics and patrol sections of the brigades and to the commanders of the escorted convoys, many of whom were still battalion-level officers.
kits: 卡面這件M4雪曼中型坦克在這場戰爭裡的位置，是新到裝備的極限示範。據公開的美方軍援交付清單，以色列在一九四八至一九四九年間獲得約八十餘輛M4A1E8雪曼，另有數輛M3A1史都華輕坦克、數十輛M8灰狗式裝甲車、數十輛M3半履帶車、牽引式M3一〇五公厘與M2一〇五公厘榴彈砲，以及數百輛各型卡車；交付批次與數目在各方記載中略有出入，可確定的是數量可觀而型號偏舊。雪曼的優點正如卡面所述：結構簡單、妥善率高、備件容易自造，一九四八年的以色列沒有能力處理更精密的歐洲戰後型坦克；代價則是車重、車寬與最小離地間隙都對狹窄起伏的山路不友好，M4A1E8的七六公厘砲雖有穿深，對上阿拉伯聯軍常見的英製輕坦克仍有距離，真正能沿公路快速反應的仍是半履帶車與M8裝甲車。以色列步兵當時使用改自英製李-恩菲爾德的步槍、輕機槍與迫擊砲，砲兵主要依賴英製六磅砲與二十五磅砲；阿拉伯聯軍同樣以英軍留下的李-恩菲爾德步槍、布倫輕機槍與外約旦裝備的英製輕坦克為骨幹，埃及空軍則駕駛噴火、鬥牛一類英美製螺旋槳機，少數阿拉伯國家另有數量不多的德製螺旋槳機可用，具體數目諸說並存。
kitsEn: The M4 Sherman on this card stands for the extreme of what new equipment could do in that war. According to the published American arms delivery lists, Israel received about eighty-odd M4A1E8 Shermans between 1948 and 1949, together with a few M3A1 Stuarts, several dozen M8 Greyhound armoured cars, several dozen M3 half-tracks, towed M3 and M2 105 mm howitzers, and several hundred trucks of various types; the batches and exact counts differ slightly between sources, but what is certain is that the numbers were substantial and the types dated. The Sherman's advantages were as the card records: simple construction, high availability and parts that could be made locally, and Israel in 1948 had no capacity to service more sophisticated post-war European tanks. The price was weight, width and ground clearance, all badly suited to narrow, broken mountain roads; the 76 mm gun of the M4A1E8 had penetration but was still outranged by the British light tanks in Arab service, and the vehicles that could actually react quickly along a road remained the half-tracks and the M8 armoured cars. Israeli infantry used rifles shortened from British Lee-Enfolds, light machine guns and mortars, and the artillery relied chiefly on British 6-pounder and 25-pounder guns. The Arab coalition likewise fought with the Lee-Enfield rifles, Bren light machine guns and British light tanks left behind by the British in Transjordan, while the Egyptian Air Force flew British and American propeller types such as the Vampire and the Audax, with a few German-designed machines still available in a small number of Arab states, where the exact numbers are disputed.
tactics: 公路在這場戰爭裡本身就是一條前線。阿拉伯聯軍佔據縱深高地與山脊上的據點，阿方的補給多沿公路與山間小徑移動，因此把切斷道路當作首要目標：三月末，特拉維夫與耶路撒冷之間的主要道路已被完全切斷。護送車隊沿途要清理伏擊點、趕修被破壞的路段，白天的車隊改走夜路，重要車隊配武裝護衛，以半履帶車與裝甲車佔領路旁高地，步兵在彎道兩側挖出射擊陣位，砲兵封鎖視界。為重新打通這條路，以色列先後執行「拿順」行動搶修公路並奪取沿線據點，四月到五月間再以「瑪卡比」作戰奪取利達機場與倫德，使空運與地運同時握在自己手裡；十月之後的「但尼」行動沿同一條走廊推進，目標正是擴大連接耶路撒冷與特拉維夫的通道並確保其安全，部隊拿下拉通與拉姆安拉之後，公路的縱深才真正打開。外約旦的阿拉伯軍團在巴布瓦德與拉通一線據守路口，以步兵佔領山頭、以砲兵封鎖彎道。公路被切斷後，以色列在十一月另闢一條碎石便道，即後來通稱的三十八號公路，把卡車隊列引向耶路撒冷，再由裝甲兵分批護送。道路因此反覆易手，每次易手都意味著一整條補給線要重新排布。
tacticsEn: The road was itself a front in this war. The Arab coalition held the heights and the strongpoints on the ridges, and its supplies moved largely along the roads and the tracks between the hills, so cutting the roads became the first priority: by the end of March the main road between Tel Aviv and Jerusalem had been completely cut. Escorted convoys had to clear ambush sites and repair broken sections of the roadway, day convoys were shifted to the night, and the important convoys were given armed escorts, with half-tracks and armoured cars holding the high ground beside the road, infantry digging firing positions on the bends and artillery sealing the approaches. To reopen the road, Israel first ran Operation Nachshon to repair it and seize the strongpoints along it, and between April and May took Lydda airport and Lydda in Operation Maccabi, so that air lift and ground movement were in the same hands; the offensive of October and after ran along the same corridor in Operation Dani, whose stated aim was to widen and secure the link between Jerusalem and Tel Aviv, and only after the capture of Latrun and Ramle was the depth of the road genuinely opened. The Arab Legion held the junctions at Bab al-Wad and Latrun, infantry on the hills and artillery covering the bends. When the road was cut, Israel opened a gravel detour in November, the road later known as the thirty-eighth, to lead the truck columns towards Jerusalem, with the armoured troops escorting them in turn. The road changed hands repeatedly, and every change meant re-laying an entire line of supply.
data: 可核對的硬數字集中在兵力與時間上。一九四八年五月十五日建國當日，以色列一方可作戰兵力約二萬九千六百七十七人；阿拉伯聯盟七國集結的兵力約二萬三千五百至二萬六千五百人之間，其中黎巴嫩約一千人、敘利亞六千人、伊拉克四千五百人、埃及五千五百人、外約旦六千至九千人，沙烏地阿拉伯與也門的數目不詳，另有數千名非正規阿拉伯士兵。阿拉伯空軍真正投入作戰的只有十幾架戰鬥機與三至四架轍炸機。兵力對比隨時間逆轉：一九四八年七月以色列國防軍約六萬五千人，阿拉伯聯軍約四萬人；同年十月阿拉伯聯軍增至約五萬五千人，一九四九年春以色列方面增至約十一萬五千人。空軍方面，以色列自捷克斯洛伐克訂購的二十五架Avia S-199自五月二十日起分批到貨；五月二十二日埃及空軍攻擊海法附近的英軍基地，五架噴火式戰鬥機被擊落，空中平衡自此逐步傾斜。軍購資金的差距同樣可查：猶太機構為購買外國軍火撥出約二千八百萬美元，而阿拉伯高級委員會當時的總預算約二百二十五萬美元。特拉維夫至耶路撒冷的公路全長約六十公里。
dataEn: The verifiable hard numbers concern manpower and time. On 14 May 1948 Israel could field about 29,677 men; the seven Arab League states mustered between roughly 23,500 and 26,500, of whom Lebanon contributed about 1,000, Syria 6,000, Iraq 4,500, Egypt 5,500 and Transjordan between 6,000 and 9,000, with the numbers from Saudi Arabia and Yemen unknown, plus several thousand irregular Arab soldiers. The Arab air forces put only a dozen or so fighters and three or four bombers into actual combat. The balance then reversed: in July 1948 the Israel Defence Forces numbered about 65,000 against roughly 40,000 for the coalition; by October the coalition had risen to about 55,000, while by the spring of 1949 the Israeli side had grown to some 115,000. In the air, the twenty-five Avia S-199s ordered by Israel from Czechoslovakia began arriving in batches from 20 May; on 22 May the Egyptian Air Force attacked the British base at Ramat David near Haifa and five Spitfires were shot down, after which the balance in the air tilted steadily. The gap in money for arms purchases is equally traceable: Jewish agencies set aside about 28 million US dollars for buying foreign weapons, while the Arab Higher Committee had a total budget of some 2.25 million dollars. The road from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem is about sixty kilometres long.
cause: 公路之所以成為焦點，是內戰地理的必然結果。分治方案把猶太人口集中於沿海平原與耶路撒冷周邊，卻把大多數高地與路口留在阿拉伯城鎮手中；山地公路因此同時是補給線、進攻軸線與可被隨手切斷的弱點。英軍在分治方案通過後即著手撤出，最後一批英軍在五月十五日離境，托管權的真空逼使兩邊都在最短時間內決定誰控制道路。一九四八年五月十四日以色列宣布建國之後，阿拉伯國家聯盟決定在英軍撤出的同一夜出兵，五月十五日凌晨的進攻在多條戰線同時展開；建國前三個月的實戰已把護送變成日常功課，而武器來源的不對等又逼使雙方都在搶時間。三月末主要道路被完全切斷，正是這條邏輯的結果：誰控制路口，誰就控制沿線每一支分遣隊。英國在停火期間向阿拉伯國家提供軍火與軍事顧問，美國猶太社群為以色列籌措購買軍火，停火期間雙方又都違反禁令補充裝備，公路爭奪因此在兩段停火之間從未真正停歇。
causeEn: The road became the focus for a reason that follows from the geography of the civil war. The partition plan concentrated the Jewish population on the coastal plain and around Jerusalem, while leaving most of the highlands and the road junctions in Arab hands; the mountain roads were at once a line of supply, an axis of attack and a weakness that could be cut at a stroke. The British began withdrawing as soon as the partition resolution was passed, and the last British troops left on 15 May, so the vacuum of the mandate forced both sides to decide who would hold the roads in the shortest possible time. After Israel declared independence on 14 May 1948, the Arab League resolved to strike on the very night the British left, and the offensive of 15 May opened on several fronts at once. The fighting of the three months before independence had already turned convoy escort into a daily task, and the unequal sources of weapons pushed both sides to race the clock. The complete cutting of the main roads by the end of March was the result of that logic: whoever holds the junctions holds every detachment along the route. Britain supplied arms and military advisers to the Arab states during the ceasefires, American Jewish communities raised money for Israeli arms purchases, and both sides broke the embargoes to replenish their stocks, so the struggle for the road never really stopped between the two ceasefires.
impact: 這場公路戰的結果，直接改變了往後數十年的中東防衛觀念。以色列由此明白，公路與補給線的安全本身就是一場戰役：護送車隊、巡邏、搶修道路，以及機場與公路之間的協同，於是被寫進作戰準則；以色列空軍最早的作用也不在爭奪縱深目標，而在掩護自家公路上的車隊。裝備面同樣留下痕跡，一九四八年成批到貨的M4雪曼讓以色列第一次擁有數量可觀的坦克，日後在一九五六年與一九六七年的戰役中仍扮演骨幹；這批車的妥善率與易維修性，讓國家的工業與後勤體系得以在不依賴外部零件的情況下維持機械化部隊。阿拉伯聯軍方面，英軍留下的英製車輛與砲兵體系，在停火線劃定後仍長期支撐著外約旦與埃及的邊境部隊；公路沿線的據點佈防，以及以色列在拉通與巴布瓦德取得的永久控制，成為其後中東各次戰爭中反覆被爭奪的固定目標。
impactEn: The outcome of this fight for the road reshaped Middle Eastern defence thinking for decades afterwards. Israel learned that the security of a road and of its line of supply is a battle in its own right: convoy escort, patrolling, road repair and the coordination between airfields and roads were written into operational doctrine, and the first task of the Israeli Air Force was not to strike targets in depth but to cover the convoys on its own roads. The equipment left a mark as well. The Sherman tanks delivered in bulk in 1948 gave Israel a substantial tank force for the first time, and they went on to serve as the backbone in the wars of 1956 and 1967; the availability and ease of maintenance of this type allowed the country's industrial and logistic system to keep a mechanised force running without depending on foreign spares. On the Arab side, the British-built vehicles and artillery system left behind by the British continued to support the Transjordanian and Egyptian border formations long after the armistice lines were drawn. The fortified points along the road, and the permanent Israeli hold on Latrun and Bab al-Wad, became fixed objectives that later Middle Eastern wars repeatedly contested.
result: 公路沒有一直是通的，但耶路撒冷也沒有被攻下。一九四八年五月十九日至二十八日的耶路撒冷巷戰，以色列守軍被逐出老城與城內的阿拉伯區，外約旦的阿拉伯軍團同樣未能把耶路撒冷變成阿拉伯聯軍的據點；從五月起直到停火，耶路撒冷對外只有一條陸路，這條路反覆被切斷又被打通。十月十五日之後的攻勢以「但尼」行動為主，隊伍沿特拉維夫與耶路撒冷之間的走廊推進，先取倫德與拉姆安拉，再奪拉通，把公路的寬度與縱深握在手中；十一月起另建的三十八號碎石便道成為替代幹線，護送任務從此固定由裝甲兵與工兵分擔。結果是一九四九年二月二十四日埃及與以色列在羅德島簽署停戰協定，三月二日外約旦跟簽，公路走廊連同拉通與耶路撒冷西側全部劃入以色列控制線。阿拉伯聯軍的切路戰術在短期內成功拖住了對方，在長期卻始終沒有奪下這條走廊；而這條公路，到今天仍是耶路撒冷與沿海平原之間唯一穩定的陸路。
resultEn: The road was not open all the time, but Jerusalem was not taken either. In the street fighting in Jerusalem from 19 to 28 May 1948 the Israeli defenders were driven out of the Old City and the Arab quarter of the town, and the Transjordanian Arab Legion likewise failed to turn Jerusalem into an Arab League base. From May until the armistice, Jerusalem had a single land outlet, and that road was cut and reopened again and again. The offensive that began on 15 October ran along the corridor between Tel Aviv and Jerusalem under Operation Dani: the columns took Lydda and Ramle first, then Latrun, and only then did they hold both the width and the depth of the road. From November the newly built gravel detour, the thirty-eighth road, served as the alternative main line, and convoy escort was from then on divided between the armoured troops and the engineers. The result was that on 24 February 1949 Egypt and Israel signed an armistice agreement on Rhodes, and on 2 March Transjordan followed; the road corridor, with Latrun and the western approaches to Jerusalem, was drawn entirely inside the Israeli lines. The Arab tactic of cutting the road worked in the short term to hold the enemy in place, but in the long run it never took the corridor. That road is still today the only stable land link between Jerusalem and the coastal plain.
